name: chrome-pixel
provenance: Captured 2026-08-24 from a headed Chromium 152.0.0.0 (Playwright build chromium-1237, launched with headless:false under Xvfb) loading a 1x1 from a local header-echo server. Verbatim apart from the dropped Host and Connection headers. A Google Chrome stable build lists a third "Google Chrome" brand in Sec-CH-UA; every other value here is identical between the two builds.
